cases.given: The process may be stuck even though each agent reports activity.
cases.expect: A grounded process-health diagnosis ready for supervisor action.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: a simple task has no meaningful process state
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: An unverifiable signal cannot be reported as a failure or a pass.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible
the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
A complex workflow may be looping or using conflicting modules.
cases.expect: The skill reports observable health evidence and a bounded status without identity claims or unauthorized repair.
cases.reject: The skill anthropomorphizes the system, infers hidden mental state, or silently reroutes modules.
